name: Orzaks Ilac Ve Kimya Sanayi Ticaret Anonim Sirketi
summary: Orzaks Ilac Ve Kimya Sanayi Ticaret Anonim Sirketi operates in the food supplement and sun protection product sectors in Turkey, and Internationally. The company offers products, such as Omega 3 products, vitamin and mineral supplements, herbal extracts, specialty supplements, musculoskeletal system, special supplements, probiotics, collagen, chewable gel supplements, immunity, sun, hair health, probiotic, and cosmetic products. The company was incorporated in 2004 and is based in Istanbul, Turkey.
